recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: neovim's dormant bitcoin treasury untouched since twenty-twenty-three
vector search teaching machines to read long documents in fragments
whispers of silicon species emerging beside us
light drizzle settling over san francisco after sunset
autumn wind barely stirring the bay at sixteen degrees
agents waiting to be spun from a pocket shortcut

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap pulse windows on a cold-storage vault display — each hit wakes a dormant bitcoin trace peeling back like layered console silicon.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: every cracked layer triggers a phosphor reveal before the vault re-seals
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: pulse windows shrink and decoy nodes multiply as deeper treasury layers unlock
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: phosphor green CRT on rain-streaked glass

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Draw cut lines through an infinitely scrolling document to chunk it at semantic breaks before fragments drift apart and vanish.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: a clean slice that lands two related paragraphs together feels like unlocking meaning
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: scroll speed rises, margins narrow, and false break points appear as decoys
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: ink wash on wet parchment with monospace overlays

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Route human prompts and silicon sparks into separate lanes — swipe to switch before hybrid species merge and break flow.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: lanes merging cleanly delivers a tiny hit of orchestrated order
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: new entity types spawn faster and lanes narrow as the queue deepens
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: split biomorphic minimalism, organic vs geometric

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Hold to tilt an umbrella angle and release to catch autumn drizzle drops in buckets before wind pushes them off-screen.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: filling the last bucket as the sky shifts from drizzle-grey to dawn gold
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: wind gusts increase, bucket sizes shrink, and decoy splashes steal capacity
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: watercolor autumn drizzle with soft paper cutout silhouettes
